method: JSON-only NumPy/SciPy FP64 algebra, no torch/model/test execution. Signed cross/noise divide sum by32 states. Smooth Fisher reevaluates softplus/sigmoid FP64 from saved FP32 logits; Euclidean fields also supplied. Noise-corrected energy exactly equals cross-energy forR2.
limitations: Two noise replicas conditional on selected states; no field-energy interval, no fixed-direction pairing, no actual update efficiency/chart/causal claim. Sampling-law bias unbounded.
